notes.title: Puzzle 3D 1.3.0.1 released
notes.notes:
Bug fixed:
	Fix a game error when rotating a piece of puzzle at a particular angle.

notes.title: Puzzle 3D 1.3.0.0 released
notes.notes:
Features added:
	New stage Magic Hat.
	Grid switch.
Bug fixed:
	Fix issue where sound doesn't trigger correctly.
	Fixed the abnormality of panning the camera with the left mouse button at special angles.
	Fixed UI anomalies in rotation at special angles.

notes.title: Puzzle 3D 1.2.2.0 released
notes.notes:
Features added:
	Choose whether to transparentize the puzzle in different planes.
	Double-click the left mouse button in the empty space to reset the lens to the center.
	Double-click the right mouse button in the empty space. If there is a selected puzzle, set the lens to the center of the puzzle.
	Drag the left mouse button in the empty space to pan the lens.
Bug fixed:
	Fix click decision.
	Fix the UI anomaly of puzzle translation and rotation.
	Fix an archive exception.
	Fix the problem of continuous triggering of sound effects.
